What this page shows

Every donation your nonprofit has received, plus a few helpful summaries. A one-time gift is a single contribution — someone gave once and that was that. A recurring gift means a donor has set up an ongoing pledge (monthly or annually), so you can expect that amount on a schedule. Recurring gifts are usually more predictable and help with planning your budget.
